why: I checked both must_catch items against the verifier brief. Item 1: Check 4 says "The live result can only be seen after merge. Do not fetch or read the live page." At the PR head it then reads .github/workflows/pages.yml to confirm the workflow still publishes docs/ on push to main, and confirms docs/index.md contains --shout. Its PASS and FAIL rules match this. Item 2: Check 2 finds the base with `git merge-base`, adds a worktree for it, and runs `node bin/greet.js Ada`, `bob` and the no-name form at both base and head. It compares stdout, plus stderr for the no-name run. PASS requires head output to match base output, so it doesn't rely only on a hand-written expected string. The exact expected strings appear only as advisory notes. Both items are handled.
